name: XRG
verdict: XRG is wholly owned by ADNOC, which is wholly owned by the Abu Dhabi Government.
note: International energy and chemicals investment company; co-title and official energy partner of UAE Team Emirates XRG from 2025 on a six-year deal. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer.
